text: Is GSE309890 the same thing as GDS309890?

No, GSE309890 and GDS309890 are not the same thing. They refer to different types of GEO entries:

- **GSE309890**: This is a GEO Series accession. It is categorized as a "GSE" entry and represents a study with multiple samples. [Details on GSE309890](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE309890) | [FTP directory](https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE309nnn/GSE309890/).

- **GDS309890**: This is a GEO DataSet accession. It is categorized as a "GDS" entry and represents a curated subset of data designed for broader reuse. [Details on GDS309890](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GDS309890) | [FTP directory](https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/datasets/GDS309nnn/GDS309890/).

They are distinct entries and may refer to different aspects or subsets of the study data.
